role: Interface for thrown entities: setThrowableHeading points a throwable (snowball, egg, ender pearl, potion, exp bottle) at a direction with speed and inaccuracy.

members.name: setThrowableHeading
members.note: the sqrt normalisation, the inaccuracy spread and the motion scale; proj_arrow_heading is EntityArrow.setArrowHeading's twin

notes: Every throwable constructor path in projectile.c routes through proj_throwable_heading (egg, snowball, potion via hostiles_witch.c, exp bottle).
